methods.explanation: The degree of x is 1, so \(|m|-1=1\), giving \(|m|=2\) and \(m=\pm2\). Also, the coefficient of x must satisfy \(m-2\ne0\), so \(m\ne2\). Therefore, \(m=-2\).
